CustomField.description: Human-readable licence state derived from the expiry date. Unknown is treated as a defect, not a neutral value.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Licence_Expiry__c), "Unknown", IF(Licence_Expiry__c < TODAY(), "Expired", IF(Licence_Expiry__c < TODAY() + 30, "Expiring soon", "Current")))
CustomField.label: Licence Status
